title: Slot and Plug Description
description: All used slots and plugs of ctrlx-barcode-reader

slots.name: package-assets
slots.purpose: Provides the package manifest, FOSS info and translations to the ctrlX Device Admin (menus, reverse proxy, scopes, app data).

slots.name: package-run
slots.purpose: Shares the folder with the web server Unix socket so the ctrlX reverse proxy can forward requests to the app.

plugs.name: network
plugs.purpose: Network client access for the ctrlX Data Layer library and for the GigE Vision camera: GVCP commands to UDP port 3956 of the camera (and a discovery broadcast to that port), the camera's replies and the GVSP image stream come back to UDP ports the OS chooses.

plugs.name: network-bind
plugs.purpose: Allows the app to create and listen on its web server Unix socket and to bind the UDP sockets Aravis receives the camera's replies and image stream on (OS-chosen ports, see portlist-description).

plugs.name: datalayer
plugs.purpose: Content interface to the ctrlX Data Layer (IPC) to provide the app's Data Layer nodes.

plugs.name: active-solution
plugs.purpose: Access to the active configuration (app data) to store and load the app settings JSON file.

plugs.name: removable-media
plugs.purpose: Optional image storage: when the user selects a USB stick or SD card in the settings, every read (or only the no-reads) is saved as an image + CSV row to <medium>/ctrlx-barcode-reader/, so nothing is written cyclically to the internal flash. Connected by the ctrlX installer.
